custom_variables.emailSubject: quick question about your brand story piece
custom_variables.emailBody:
Hey Studio Think team,

Just read Telling Tales, Making Sales: Why CEOs should care more than ever about brand story. Small thing, but the header image is labelled "About Us" rather than anything about brand story.

I run a motion studio. Happy to swap founder quotes: one from me for the "What are the key elements of a brand story?" section, and one from your side for ours.

In return, a credit link back to motiontheagency.com with my quote, one to yours with your quote on ours, or we'll pay for placement instead.

Would you be open to exploring this?

Cheers,
Sam
custom_variables.articleTitle: Telling Tales, Making Sales: Why CEOs should care more than ever about brand story.
